text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This year, the Goshiki Shuntaisai would 
finally take place. 
The Shinme and all participants were 
putting 
the finishing touches on their 
preparations.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And directing an especially 
serious gaze was--

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...If it's around this point...?  
...No, then that would mean...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huh?! N-No, it's just--

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... But I haven't sorted out 
any of my thoughts yet... Argh...!
choice_data_list:
"Not sorted out"? Are you planning 
something?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, exactly. 
Or more like, something I want to try.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Remember when we saw that "older 
girl's" 
giant mikoshi pull back in Yukino's 
hometown?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ever since then, it's been bugging me. 
Maybe it's time for us to change, too.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. That older girl said it, didn't she? 
"The mikoshi grew bigger over time." 
And besides--

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
--the longer horsegirls have spent 
alongside humans, 
the further they've been able to push past 
their limits. 
That's what I realized.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Because the more time we share with them, 
the greater the volume of dreams we 
receive from humans.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I think that was true for Yukino back 
then, too. 
Ever since she was little, people were 
always by her side.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
But couldn't the exact same thing 
be said for us, too? 
We've always had people around us, and--

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
horsegirls today have spent vastly more 
time together with humans than those in 
the past.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
For generations upon generations, from 
grandmothers to mothers-- 
we've continued our bond with humans, and 
that led to who "we" are today.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
With so many inherited dreams backing us 
up, 
doesn't it feel like we could do something 
amazing? 
...Shouldn't we be able to make something 
happen?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Just like how we keep breaking the course 
records of the past. 
If there's something only we can do now--!
choice_data_list: You want to try something new yourselves?

Do you want to try something new 
yourselves?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...If it's impossible, just say so. 
To be honest, I don't even know if it's 
our place 
to tamper with a tradition preserved for 
so long.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Even so--
choice_data_list:
There's no harm in thinking about it, 
right?
Isn't it fine to give it some thought?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Over the past two years, the Shinme have 
grown 
incredibly reliable. They can certainly 
handle 
a few minor adjustments.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And above all else, we have...
choice_data_list: Let's figure it out together, Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...the bonds we've forged across all this 
time.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
What's up, Trainer?! 
You said there's somethin' ya wanna think 
over together--?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Shinme gathered one after another. 
While explaining the situation to them, 
we could also consult the traditional 
organizations.
choice_data_list: All right, let's put our heads together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, as the "horsegirls of today," 
they began exploring what new elements 
they could add 
to the sacred rites of the Goshiki 
Shuntaisai.

title: Not as the Past, but as the Present
